title: Tarazona 1500 (Missale Tirasonense): complete strict Canon Missae constituent — independent pixel-collation review
scope: Complete strict Eucharistic Canon of the 13 February 1500 Tarazona-use missal printed at Pamplona by Arnaldo Guillén de Brocar (Bizkaia INC-35, PDF pp. 350-354): from the woodcut initial Te igitur at PDF p. 350 col. 1 through Et uoce alta dicit. Per omnia secula seculorum. R. Amen. at PDF p. 354 col. 1 immediately before Oremus preceptis salutaribus / Pater noster. Includes all printed headings, action rubrics, red N. placeholders and 26 printed crosses (✠) under declared selective Latin reading normalization.
method: Independent pixel-level visual inspection of all rendered facsimile pages by independent-collator-v3-alex-west (distinct from drafter AI source transcriber (Lane T3, direct PNG inspection of Tarazona 1500 PDF pp. 350-354)) on 2026-11-25. Applied 25 pixel-verified correction(s) relative to initial draft; verified every unit boundary, page account (1..658), and SHA-256 hash.
normalization_limit: Direct reading from 220-dpi rendered PNG images of Tarazona 1500 PDF pp. 350-354. UTF-8 NFC, LF line endings. Standard 1500 Gothic Latin abbreviations expanded silently to reading forms (nasal macrons, -q3 -> -que, -3/-z -> -m/-us in cenatuz/enĩ3/peccatoru3/cuz/aliquaz/societatez/Panez/tuuz, -b9/-9 -> -bus/-us, Tironian ⁊ -> et, ꝝ -> -rum, p̃/ꝓ -> per/pro, oꝑs -> omnipotens, q̃sumus -> quesumus, dñs/dñi/dñm/dñe -> dominus/domini/dominum/domine, nr̃o/nr̃m -> nostro/nostrum, xꝑi/xꝑm -> christi/christum, oẽs -> omnes, Oȓo. -> Oratio., sctĩ/sãcta/sacrosc̃tm -> sancti/sancta/sacrosanctum, bñ -> bene, p̃stas -> prestas, ĩpo -> ipso, p̃ri -> patri, ℟ -> R.). Woodcut display initial + second capital (TE, ME, CO, HA, QU, UN, SU, NO, PE) normalized to sentence case. Long s normalized to s; diagonal line-end hyphens (/) joined. Medieval Latin orthography preserved verbatim (e for ae/oe: Hec, que, celum, eterni, preclare, venie; u/v as printed (Gothic word-initial v / medial u); circunstantium; ij in Cornelij, Laurentij, filij, refrigerij; Grisogoni, Mathia, Symonis, Thadei, Sixti, misterium, propicio). Headings and action rubrics occupy their own lines; printed crosses serialized as ✠ (26 crosses total, preserving word-internal positions).
review_limit: Complete declared constituent only, not whole-book transcription or diplomatic typography.
